claims.claim: Elo says it began in 2011 with debit and credit cards and describes itself as a 100% Brazilian company.
claims.quote: A Elo começou em 2011, com cartões de débito e crédito.
claims.title: Sobre a Elo
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Gloss: 'Elo started in 2011 with debit and credit cards.' The page's 'Nossos números' block rendered as placeholders (0M, 0B, +0), so no card or volume figures could be read from Elo's own site. Ownership by Banco do Brasil, Bradesco and Caixa is not stated on this page.

claims.claim: Portuguese Wikipedia states Elo has more than 132 million cards issued and calls it the largest brand in Brazil; the infobox lists Elo Participações S.A. and Caixa Econômica Federal as owners (58.48% / 41.42% per the fetched summary) with HQ in Barueri, SP.
claims.quote: mais de 132 milhões de cartões emitidos com a bandeira Elo
claims.title: Elo (cartão) - Wikipédia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Gloss: 'more than 132 million cards issued under the Elo brand.' Figure is undated on the page as fetched. Ownership percentages come from the fetch summary of the infobox, not a verbatim sentence; Elo Participações is the BB/Bradesco holding vehicle. No primary ownership document was reachable (SEC full-text search returned Forbidden).

claims.claim: Elo's international acceptance has run since 2016 through Discover in the US and Diners Club International elsewhere.
claims.quote: passando a ser aceita nos Estados Unidos como Discover Card e, no restante do mundo, como Diners Club International
claims.title: Elo (cartão) - Wikipédia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Gloss: 'becoming accepted in the United States as Discover Card and, in the rest of the world, as Diners Club International.' Discover Global Network, PULSE and Diners Club are Capital One-owned since 18 May 2025; the source predates or does not mention this.

claims.claim: Elo markets acceptance in more than 200 countries and territories for purchases, and ATM access at more than 1.2 million ATMs in more than 140 countries, via PULSE and Discover (US, Canada, Mexico, Caribbean) and Diners Club elsewhere.
claims.quote: mais de 1,2 milhões de caixas eletrônicos em mais de 140 países
claims.title: Aceitação internacional Elo
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Gloss: 'more than 1.2 million ATMs in more than 140 countries.' The page also says 'mais de 200 países e territórios' for purchases and links the Diners Club Cash ATM locator (dinersclubcash.com). Page is cardholder-facing but documents the alliance structure.

claims.claim: The Elo rulebook defines both domestic and cross-border (transfronteiriço) payment arrangements, and a card may give access to one or both.
claims.quote: apenas a um Arranjo de Pagamento Doméstico; (ii) apenas a um Arranjo de Pagamento Transfronteiriço ou (iii) tanto para o Arranjo de Pagamento Doméstico quanto
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'only a Domestic Payment Arrangement; (ii) only a Cross-border Payment Arrangement, or (iii) both.' Article 4. Elo runs several BCB-registered arrangements (Pós-Pago, Pré-Pago, Depósito/Compra/Doméstico, Transferência).

claims.claim: Elo's brand family (card variants) named in the rulebook is Básico (Nacional/Internacional), Débito, Pré-Pago, Elo Mais, Elo Grafite, Elo Nanquim and Elo Diners Club.
claims.quote: para as variantes Elo Mais, Elo Grafite, Elo Nanquim e Elo Diners Club e como opcional para as variantes Débito, Pré -Pago, Básico Nacional
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'for the variants Elo Mais, Elo Grafite, Elo Nanquim and Elo Diners Club, and optional for Débito, Pré-Pago, Básico Nacional and Básico Internacional.' Elo Diners Club is a co-badged variant with the Capital One-owned Diners Club brand.

claims.claim: Elo publishes its participant list because the Central Bank requires it, listing participants that registered with the CIP clearing house; the count and roles are rendered by JavaScript and were not readable without a browser.
claims.quote: a Elo divulga abaixo a lista de participantes dos seus arranjos de pagamento que devidamente se habilitaram junto à CIP
claims.title: Participantes do arranjo
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'Elo publishes below the list of participants in its payment arrangements that duly registered with CIP.' The table returned zero rows to the fetcher; the 352-participant figure given in the assignment could not be confirmed and is recorded in not_found. Role filters visible: Emissor, Credenciador, Subcredenciador, Facilitador.

claims.claim: Elo's public rulebook is the 'Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO', version 13.0 dated 11 May 2026, published as a 694-page PDF that bundles the in-force version and a version awaiting Central Bank approval.
claims.quote: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO Versão 13.0 | 11 de maio de 2026
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Linked from the elo.com.br footer under 'Regras do arranjo Elo > Regulamento Elo'. Cover page 1: '(i) Regulamento Elo vigente; (I) Regulamento Elo em aprovação pelo Banco Central do Brasil.' The PDF is hosted on a 'strapi-hml' (homologation) media path. The document carries a confidentiality notice despite being publicly linked.

claims.claim: The rulebook version history shows 13 editions since v1.0 on 2 June 2017; v11.0 (29 Jan 2025) added the Doméstico/Transferência/PósPago arrangement rules and v13.0 (11 May 2026) added the fee and penalty schedule under BCB Resolution 522.
claims.quote: Versão com inclusão da relação de tarifas e penalidades, decorrente da Resolução BCB nº 522 (sem alterações materiais) 13.0 11.05.2026
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'Version including the list of fees and penalties, arising from BCB Resolution 522 (no material changes) 13.0 11.05.2026.' Other dated editions: 10.0 (02.03.2023, Res. BCB 246/2022 adjustments), 12.0 (06.01.2025, Circular BCB 3978). Note v12.0 is dated earlier than v11.0 in the table as printed.

claims.claim: Changes to the rulebook or arrangement manuals on governed subjects are communicated in advance to participants, who get 21 calendar days to submit comments.
claims.quote: serão previamente comunicadas aos Participantes e lhes será dado 21 (vinte e um) dias corridos para o envio de manifestações, propostas e/ou su
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'will be communicated in advance to Participants, who will be given 21 calendar days to send comments, proposals and/or suggestions.' Portal logins are 'defined according to the nature and role of the Participant ... per a specific published bulletin' (boletim). No public bulletin archive was found.

claims.claim: Elo's dispute framework has four chargeback stages, each of which may carry a fee: presentment, re-presentment, pre-arbitration and arbitration.
claims.quote: (i) apresentação; (ii) reapresentação (devolução); (iii) Pré-Arbitragem; e (iv) Arbitragem.
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Detailed rules sit in the 'Manual de Regras Operacionais Elo' and 'Anexo IV Manual de Tarifas, Produtos e Serviços'; fee amounts vary by transaction and are not printed in the public PDF.

claims.claim: Named compliance programmes in the fee annex include the Programa de Conformidade Elo (mandatory), the Programa de Auditoria de Estabelecimento Comercial (PAEC), the VPCE card personalisation validation, and PCI-DSS certification obligations for acquirers.
claims.quote: A tarifa referente ao Programa de Conformidade Elo é um valor, expresso em reais, da aderência dos ambientes de tecnologia e dos processos de riscos
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'The fee for the Elo Compliance Programme is an amount in reais for the adherence of technology environments and risk processes.' Headings 10.9 PAEC [M], 10.10 Programa de Conformidade Elo [M], 11.8 VPCE [M]; acquirers must meet 'exigências para certificação junto ao PCI-DSS'.

claims.claim: Sub-acquirers with under R$500 million in accumulated transactions over 12 months must still receive Elo flows through the clearing house settlement, and must notify Elo when they cross the threshold.
claims.quote: seja inferior a R$ 500.000.000,00 (quinhentos milhões de reais), é obrigatória para o recebimento dos fluxos referentes às Transações de Pagamento
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'below R$500,000,000.00, is mandatory for receiving flows relating to Payment Transactions.' Reflects BCB centralised-settlement rules for subcredenciadores via CIP.

claims.claim: The rulebook caps interchange at 0.5% per transaction for the Elo Depósito (debit) domestic purchase arrangement and 0.7% for the Elo Pré-Pago (prepaid) domestic purchase arrangement.
claims.quote: no Arranjo de Pagamento Elo Depósito/Compra/Doméstico será de 0,5% (cinco décimos por cento); e (ii) o limite máximo relativo à tarifa de intercâmbio
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'in the Elo Deposit/Purchase/Domestic arrangement will be 0.5%; and (ii) the maximum interchange limit ... Prepaid/Purchase/Domestic will be 0.7%.' These mirror the BCB Resolution 246/2022 caps; the BCB normative page itself could not be fetched (SPA). Credit interchange is set by the 'Manual de Remuneração Emissor', which is not public.

claims.claim: Elo's fee annex describes mechanisms but not amounts; fee values are distributed to participants through the Portal de Parceiros Elo according to their participation modality.
claims.quote: são disponibilizados periodicamente a todos os Participantes por meio do Portal de Parceiros Elo, conforme a modalidade de participação de cada um
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'are made available periodically to all Participants through the Elo Partner Portal, according to each one's participation modality.' Companion documents named: 'Relação de Tarifas Emissor', 'Relação de Tarifas Credenciador', 'Manual de Certificação dos Subcredenciadores' (none public).

claims.claim: The brand licence fee is a percentage of issuer turnover that varies by product, billed monthly; the acquirer-side brand development fee is set by MCC, annual Elo volume and rail (debit, credit, instalment).
claims.quote: A Tarifa é um percentual aplicado sobre o faturamento do emissor, referente à licença de uso da marca Elo.
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'The fee is a percentage applied to the issuer's turnover for the Elo brand licence; the percentage varies by product.' Headings 10.1 and 10.2. Percentages are not printed. 'Fee especial' by CNPJ vs 'fee padrão' by MCC indicates negotiated merchant-level pricing.

claims.claim: Joining fee: a fixed amount in reais sized on the average time for certification and technical homologation; and a per-CNPJ monthly fee is charged for Portal de Parceiros Elo access to issuers, acquirers and sub-acquirers.
claims.quote: Tarifa de valor fixo, expresso em reais, que será cobrada pela Elo pelo acesso e utilização do Portal de Parceiros Elo
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'Fixed fee in reais charged by Elo for access to and use of the Elo Partner Portal.' Heading 10.7 [M]; 10.4 'Adesão de Participantes ao Arranjo de Pagamento Elo [M]' says the fee 'é um valor fixo, em reais, referente à adesão dos Participantes'. Amounts not published.

claims.claim: International fees are denominated in US dollars: an annual 'Acesso à rede Internacional' fee per access grant, and an ATM-use fee comprising interchange, routing and international processing charges for ATM transactions outside Brazil.
claims.quote: é um valor, expresso em dólares (US$), referente às transações financeiras e não financeiras realizadas em caixas eletrônicos (ATMs) fora do território brasileiro
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'an amount in US dollars for financial and non-financial transactions at ATMs outside Brazilian territory.' Headings 11.3 [M][T] and 11.4 [M][T]. Cross-border ATM activity rides the Discover/PULSE/Diners alliance.

claims.claim: Any entity meeting the rulebook requirements may apply in writing to become a participant; Elo may admit or refuse with a justified written notice, a refused applicant may ask for reconsideration within 5 days, Elo answers within 5 days, and admission is formalised by a Participation Contract plus payment of the fees.
claims.quote: A solicitação para se tornar um Participante deve ser feita por escrito à Elo.
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'The request to become a Participant must be made in writing to Elo.' Articles 172-174. No online application form or fintech fast-track is published; there is no published timeline for the overall process.

claims.claim: Participant modalities defined in Chapter XI are post-paid issuer, prepaid issuer, deposit (debit) issuer, acquirer, sub-acquirer, network service provider, domicile institution, originating participant, payment transaction initiator and transactional digital wallet.
claims.quote: Subseção V - Subcredenciadores ... Subseção VI - Prestadores de Serviço de Rede ... Subseção VII - Instituições Domicílio
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Table-of-contents entries (pp. 93-109 of the in-force version): Emissores Pós-Pago, Pré-Pago, Depósito; Credenciadores; Subcredenciadores; Prestadores de Serviço de Rede; Instituições Domicílio; Participante Originador; Iniciador de Transação de Pagamento; Carteira Digital Transacional. Ellipses in the quote mark omitted page numbers.

claims.claim: Elo runs a BIN Sponsorship programme under which a sponsoring issuer is responsible for its BIN partners and may not pass full payee data to partners not authorised by the Central Bank.
claims.quote: responsabilizar-se pelos Parceiros de BIN com os quais o Emissor estabeleça acordo comercial para atuação como Emissor Patrocinador, nos termos do Programa de BIN Sponsorship
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'take responsibility for the BIN Partners with which the Issuer signs a commercial agreement to act as Sponsor Issuer, under the BIN Sponsorship Programme.' This is Elo's sponsor route for fintechs and programme managers.

claims.claim: Certification for new partners becomes chargeable if custom certification exceeds 90 business days; release certifications run in a published 'Janela de Certificação' presented at a Forum, and re-certification applies on processor changes.
claims.quote: Haverá cobrança se o prazo de certificação customizada ultrapassar o período de 90 (noventa) dias úteis
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'There will be a charge if custom certification exceeds 90 business days.' Heading 10.15 'Certificação / Implementação Customizada [O]'. Certification uses the mandatory 'Simulador Elo' (11.1/11.2) to simulate capture and transmission of transactions.

claims.claim: Fraud and risk products for issuers include Elo Áquila (machine-learning transaction score 0-999, mandatory score fee, optional rules engine and case manager), Rede de Segurança Elo, Elo Lyra, Elo Emailage, Elo Valida SIM Card, Elo Valida Dados and a HUB de Segurança.
claims.quote: O Elo Áquila é uma solução de Prevenção a Fraudes transacionais da Elo, que disponibiliza aos emissores Elo um score transacional
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'Elo Áquila is Elo's transactional fraud prevention solution, giving Elo issuers a transaction score generated from a statistical model.' Headings 12.1-12.8 of Anexo IV; Emailage is a LexisNexis product resold under the Elo name.

claims.claim: Tokenisation and authentication services: Elo operates its own token service provider (TSP ELO), sells Dynamic Token and Token Ativo for digital products, Setup de Xpays for wallet provisioning, and an EMV 3DS programme with issuer, acquirer, 3DS Server and ACS roles.
claims.quote: TSP ELO Serviço provedor de tokens da Elo. Responsável pela tokenização e destokenização, além de validações criptográficas das transações tokenizadas.
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'TSP ELO: Elo's token service provider, responsible for tokenisation and detokenisation plus cryptographic validation of tokenised transactions.' Headings 11.13 Setup de Xpays [O], 11.14 Dynamic Token [O], 11.15 Token Ativo [O], 12.4 Programa 3DS Elo EMV 3DS [O]. All optional (value-added) except where marked [M].

claims.claim: ATM services: 'Produto Elo Saque' bills issuers per successful withdrawal or enquiry on Elo's affiliated ATM network, and 'Produto HubDigital TecBan' processes withdrawals through TecBan's HubDigital for issuers that contract it.
claims.quote: A tarifa será cobrada pelo processamento das transações realizadas por emissores que contrataram o serviço de saque via HubDigital da Tecban.
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'The fee is charged for processing transactions made by issuers that contracted the withdrawal service via TecBan's HubDigital.' Headings 14.1 and 14.2, both optional. No ATM-deployer-facing programme is published; the ATM relationship is issuer-side via TecBan (Banco24Horas).

claims.claim: Core network services in the annex include authorisation message processing, account verification transactions, daily collateral posting, stand-in authorisation contingency (three variants), Elobridge SD-WAN connectivity, HUB QR Code, terminal validation, cashback and the SIC integrated communication system.
claims.quote: A Tarifa Conectividade Elobridge -SDWAN é um serviço de conectividade entre os Participantes dos Arranjos de Pagamento Elo, com valor fixo em reais
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'The Elobridge SD-WAN Connectivity fee is a connectivity service between Participants of the Elo Payment Arrangements, at a fixed amount in reais.' Mandatory [M]: 10.5 Processamento na Mensageria de Autorizações, 10.6 Transação Verificação de Conta, 10.8 aporte diário de Garantias. Optional [O]: 11.10-11.12 Stand-in, 11.16 HUB QR Code, 11.17-11.18 terminal validation, 10.16 Cashback, 12.9 SIC.

claims.claim: Data and loyalty services: optional reports for issuers and acquirers (performance and benchmarking, positioning and opportunity, brand affinity, lifecycle segmentation, upgrade recommendation), mandatory benefit packages per variant, and a prepaid/benefits programme-manager stack (issuer setup, embossing, onboarding, cardholder app, TecBan withdrawals).
claims.quote: Relatório de Performance e Benchmarking – Emissor [O]
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Second fee annex (numbering restarts at 10.1 'Cadastro de Usuários no Portal de Serviços Elo'). Headings 11.1-11.5 data reports, 13.1-13.4 benefits (Benefícios Mandatórios/Flex/Opcionais for PF and PJ), 13.1-13.15 programme services incl. 'Portal de Gestão, Processamento, Recarga, Onboarding, Atendimento e App Portador [M]'.

claims.claim: Elo sells a data-driven consulting service, 'Elo Performance e Insights', to issuers, acquirers and retailers with three pillars: Analytics, Campaigns and Innovation.
claims.quote: É um serviço que nasce com a união do know how Elo e a riqueza de nossos dados transacionais
claims.title: Consultoria - Elo Performance e Insights
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Gloss: 'It is a service born from combining Elo's know-how with the richness of our transactional data.' Audience stated as emissores, credenciadores and varejistas. A contact email is present but Cloudflare-obfuscated on the page.

claims.claim: The rulebook states it is available at www.elo.com.br and at portalelo.com.br/b2b, naming the B2B partner portal; the rulebook separately refers to the 'Portal de Parceiros Elo' and the 'Portal de Serviços Elo' as the gated distribution channel for fees, bulletins and support tickets.
claims.quote: DISPONÍVEL: www.elo.com.br portalelo.com.br/b2b
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The assignment's Portal.Elo address elonegocios.cartaoelo.com.br did not resolve in DNS on 2026-09-25 (curl error 6). portalelo.com.br/b2b was not fetched (budget). Both are gated.

claims.claim: Dev.Elo (dev.elo.com.br) is a Next.js single-page app that serves only a 'Carregando...' shell without JavaScript; no API reference, product list, sandbox details or sign-up text is readable by a plain fetch, and sub-routes such as /apis return 404.
claims.quote: ELO - Desenvolvedores
claims.title: ELO - Desenvolvedores
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page HTML is 6 KB; content loads through portal-dev-elo-router.apis-prd.elo.com.br (Cloudflare cdn-cgi). The homepage footer links it as 'Dev.Elo' under 'Serviços'. The assignment's description (Soluções, APIs, Tutoriais, Central de Ajuda, self-service sign-up, modernisation notice, portal-dev@elo.com.br) could not be confirmed without a browser; recorded in not_found.

claims.claim: Partner support runs through the Centro de Operações Elo (COE), which handles second-level authorisation and settlement issues plus direct partner tickets on chargeback, settlement, reconciliation and Portal Elo, and is monitored on an 8x5 basis.
claims.quote: Chargeback, Liquidação, Batimento Contábil, Portal Elo, Dúvidas Gerais. Esse monitoramento é realizado pelo Centro de Operações Elo – COE 8X5
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'Chargeback, Settlement, Accounting Reconciliation, Elo Portal, General Questions. This monitoring is carried out by the Elo Operations Centre, COE, 8x5.' Elsewhere: partners with portal access 'podem encaminhar suas dúvidas e solicitações de suporte através de chamado para o Centro de Operações Elo (COE)'. No SLAs, phone numbers or languages are published; the site's 'Canais de contato' page shows empty issuer/acquirer contact blocks.

claims.claim: Elo offers paid training under the name 'Universidade Elo', billed per enrollee to issuers, acquirers, sub-acquirers and processors, and a rulebook 'Fórum' where release certification windows are presented.
claims.quote: São treinamentos ministrados pela Elo no âmbito dos seus arranjos de pagamento, cobrados em reais (R$).
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'Training delivered by Elo within its payment arrangements, charged in reais.' Heading 10.13 Universidade Elo [O]; 12.1.3 HUB de Segurança – Treinamento and 12.2.4 Elo Áquila – Treinamento are product-specific training fees.

claims.claim: On 24 May 2024 Elo announced the largest rebrand in its history, saying it would stay a card company with a broader technology repertoire and citing Drex, tokenisation and smart-contract initiatives.
claims.quote: Continuaremos a ser uma empresa de cartões, mas, com um repertório mais plural, ágil e tecnologicamente mais robusto
claims.title: Elo anuncia maior mudança de marca de sua história
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Gloss: 'We will continue to be a card company, but with a more plural, agile and technologically more robust repertoire.' Predates the Capital One-Discover close (18 May 2025). This is the only release listed on the press page; no 2025-2026 releases were visible.

claims.claim: Regulatory-driven rulebook mandates in the last 24 months: v11.0 on 29 Jan 2025 (Doméstico/Transferência/PósPago arrangement rules), v12.0 dated 06 Jan 2025 (Circular BCB 3978 adjustments) and v13.0 on 11 May 2026 (fee and penalty list per Resolução BCB 522).
claims.quote: Versão com as regras do Arranjo de Pagamento Doméstico/Transferência/PósPago 11.0 29.01.2025
claims.title: Regulamento dos Arranjos de Pagamento ELO, Versão 13.0
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Gloss: 'Version with the rules of the Domestic/Transfer/Post-paid Payment Arrangement 11.0 29.01.2025.' No M&A, leadership, outage or pricing-change news could be gathered because web search was unavailable in this session; see not_found.

contradictions.a: elo.com.br footer labels https://termos-e-regulamentos.elo.com.br/bacen.pdf as 'Participantes do arranjo'
contradictions.b: The bacen.pdf file is actually a 164-page 'REGULAMENTO ELO VERSÃO EM APROVAÇÃO PELO BANCO CENTRAL DO BRASIL' dated 01.12.2021, not a participant list

contradictions.b: Same table lists the later-numbered v12.0 dated 06.01.2025 (earlier date)
